visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a full shot of an assembled LEGO Black Pearl pirate ship sitting on a wooden table against a dual-tone blue and pink studio backdrop. Large digital overlays of the LEGO logo and the Pirates of the Caribbean movie title appear in the center. (2) Real human hands with sparkling nail polish pour a large bag of LEGO bricks onto the table, creating a chaotic pile of multicolored parts. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up where the hands assemble the Jack Sparrow minifigure, meticulously attaching the torso, head, and iconic pirate hat. (4) A rapid stop-motion sequence shows the black hull of the ship growing from a flat base, with internal support structures and colorful interior bricks being layered. (5) Hands install rows of brown and black cannons along the lower deck while various pirate characters are placed in different sections of the ship. (6) The construction progresses to the upper decks and the captain's cabin, featuring intricate details like a steering wheel and lanterns. (7) Finally, the large black sails are attached to the masts, and the completed ship is displayed from multiple angles, highlighting the figurehead and the skull-and-crossbones flag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic orchestral swell featuring prominent violin strings and a steady, driving drum beat in a minor key. A loud rustling sound of plastic bags and bricks falling marks the start. (2) Rapid mechanical clicks and snapping sound effects are layered over the music, synchronized with the building of the ship. The tempo remains fast and constant. (3) Occasional comedic vocal chirps, including a pirate-style laugh and a short 'Ahoy!', are heard as minifigures appear. These are interspersed with sharp whoosh transition effects. (4) The music intensifies in volume and percussive density towards the end, culminating in a triumphant orchestral finale with synthesized brass and heavy timpani hits.
